svg.title: Specimen: what I make, what I make it with, and how.
svg.desc: A three-column specimen sheet. What: interfaces and design systems, brand identities, web applications, browser extensions, desktop software. With: a type waterfall of Figma, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Rust, Tauri, Node.js, WordPress. How: local-first, private by default, typography is interface, ship small and refine often. Below, the palette of this page with hex values.
